name: [Equip] Translation queue is not draining
message:
The translation queue has had work in it continuously for two hours.

The worker runs every minute and pauses itself on a time budget, so a large course legitimately takes several ticks — but never two hours of never reaching empty. That pattern means the queue is being refilled as fast as it drains, or a job is failing and being re-queued.

Where to look:
* `GET /api/v1/internal/translation-queue/health` — per-status counts.
* `POST /api/v1/admin/translations/queue-status` — `stuck_jobs` and each job's `attempts` and `last_error`; `last_error` names the cause directly.
* A course whose every tick reports progress but never finishes is the sweep and the worker fighting over the same course; check `courses.translations_checked_at`.

@arvavitcorp@gmail.com

NO DATA IS AN ALERT HERE, deliberately, against the house rule that every monitor sets notify_no_data=false. That rule is right for a spike monitor and wrong for this one: `equip.translation.queue_depth` is emitted only by the worker tick itself, so the metric going quiet does not mean the queue is empty — it means the worker stopped running, which is the most severe failure this monitor exists to catch and the one it would otherwise answer with silence.
